claim: A Journal of Medical Genetics letter reported replication of KIF21B as a susceptibility locus for multiple sclerosis and noted prior establishment of KIF21B as a susceptibility locus for inflammatory bowel disease and MS.
future_grounding_route: Use only as segregated literature context unless the exact SNP-level data are re-imported and compared to the project's chr1 eQTL/colocalization analysis.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: chr1 KIF21B/GPR25 locus resolves to real biology but hard target

project_use: External literature context for the KIF21B side of the chr1 locus; not evidence for therapeutic tractability or direction-matched intervention.
relationship_note: The source converges on KIF21B as a real susceptibility-locus context, but does not resolve whether KIF21B is the causal transcript or whether its project-inferred direction is druggable.

source.citation: Goris et al. Replication of KIF21B as a susceptibility locus for multiple sclerosis. Journal of Medical Genetics. 2010.
source.label: JMG KIF21B MS susceptibility replication

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: PubMed bibliographic metadata and short paraphrase only
source_terms.reuse_notes: V50 stores bibliographic metadata and a short paraphrased claim only; do not redistribute article text or treat it as project-grounded evidence.

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun the external study's genotype association analysis in the external layer.
